variants.title: 高架下、水路沿いの薬房
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE full-bleed tall portrait 9:19.5 pixel-art completed rank5 scene for a lofi focus app. Reference image is visual-style and character reference only; NEW LOCATION AND COMPOSITION, do not reproduce rooftop terrace.
Keep detailed visible pixel clusters, stepped contours, nuanced blue-violet shadows and amber lamps, muted teal medicinal-liquid accent, quietly lived-in contemporary Japanese environment. Intimate emotional chill lofi mood, everyday reality with one gentle impossible detail: a very small anthropomorphic black cat pharmacist quietly working. No medieval fantasy, castle, wizard robes or steampunk.
Composition environment-first: depth-rich streetscape and water/sky/architecture dominate, cat full seated silhouette only 7-9% image height, workbench no more than 22% picture width, tucked off-center, discoverable secondary detail. Cat wears loose charcoal sweatshirt with plain work apron, small feline head/ears, black paws and long tail, no human face/hair or giant mascot. Tiny cat checks notebook and flask under a warm task lamp. A small realistic borosilicate distillation rig with faint mint liquid, digital scale, a few amber bottles, a little laptop and herb planters signal a personal potion-making studio. Cozy grown-in equipment, not empty, not cluttered. Open-air work area naturally sheltered by awning, surroundings are main subject. No other characters. No UI, text, statusbar, watermark, frame or collage. Avoid oversized cat, close-up, giant tanks or sprawling machinery.
SCENE A: A narrow quiet canal in an ordinary old Japanese city district after sunset. View obliquely ALONG the water from a stone footpath, low viewpoint with several depth layers. An elevated railway of weathered concrete crosses the upper-middle diagonally; a short train with warm windows passes above. Tucked beneath an arch on the LEFT midground is a small open-front apothecary work shed, amber lamp under corrugated canopy, tiny working cat and compact table visible outside. Small low storefronts with shutters, pipes and potted plants hug the canal; narrow footbridge far behind, apartment balconies and overhead cables beyond. Foreground water reflections and planted stone bank frame the tiny shop, broad moody blue space under bridge gives atmosphere. A few cyan sign shapes without readable lettering. Main feeling hidden cozy nook in familiar urban infrastructure. NOT rooftop, NOT wide luxury waterfront, no giant skyline.

SCENE B: An old Japanese coastal hillside neighborhood at blue hour, looking downhill along a narrow irregular stone stair lane toward a quiet harbor and lavender horizon. Weathered modest houses, balconies, roof tiles, utility wires and potted rosemary create layered intimate depth. A tiny open-front formulation workshop occupies the RIGHT midground side of the lane under a faded fabric awning, ordinary sliding glass door behind it, small outside worktable illuminated amber with tiny black cat.
